{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()

# Output the result
best_segment"}
